authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Does the canonical square fixed-charge single-path switching graph saturate the smaller logical sector at every size, and what separate probabilistic statement would turn that structure into a nonzero limiting Bayes-risk bound?
claim_boundary: An all-size matching theorem would identify the Bayes numerator combinatorially but would not by itself lower-bound its normalized density. Keep structural saturation and probabilistic nonvanishing as separate claims.
alternatives: Prove all-size minority-sector saturation through a fixed-divergence flow/orientation exchange theorem, then isolate the independent matching-density lemma.
Find a canonical-square Hall counterexample or missing exchange condition, closing single-path saturation as an all-size identity.
Show reviewed combinatorial results do not cover this graph and record the precise unproved lemma without promoting a threshold claim.
planned_steps: Search primary combinatorics literature for normalized matching, symmetric-chain, orientation-reversal, and fixed-divergence flow results whose hypotheses match this public graph.
Formalize the path-switching graph and test whether its connected components admit an order, exchange, or injection proof; use only the exact L3/L4 tables as controls.
Attempt the smallest proof/counterexample matrix covering all candidate mechanisms, and state separately the probabilistic lower bound still needed for positive normalized matching density.
Stop without a midpoint noncorrectability or threshold claim unless both the all-size structural statement and a size-uniform density bound are proved.
stop_rule: Stop at an all-size proof, a canonical counterexample, or an explicit missing-lemma boundary after primary-source review. Do not enumerate L5, fit a two-size trend, or identify p=1/2 as a decoding threshold.

observed.alpha_orientation_embedding: Exact for every L3/L4 state after contracting all rough-boundary vertices to one outer root; fixed charge fixes all outdegrees.
observed.primary_source_boundary: Published planar alpha-orientation and circulation lattices include internal cycle or facial moves excluded from the opposite-rough-arc logical switching graph; no reviewed theorem supplies its normalized matching property.
observed.missing_lemmas: Restricted-graph normalized matching is structural; a positive size-uniform normalized minority-mass bound is independently required for midpoint noncorrectability.

decision: Stop at the explicit missing-theorem boundary. Promote exact finite normalized matching and robustness only; do not promote an all-size theorem, midpoint noncorrectability, or a decoding threshold.
